what_happened: Cluster member phase_commit_drops_own_plan_artifact describes a code defect (own-task-directory not admitted by git-commit-phase.sh is_contained) that the source store already closed on 2026-11-06 (commit eeacd7d47, own-task-directory splice, pinned by test-git-commit-phase.sh Cases 15-16); only the false 'structurally outside its reach' sentence in git-staging-scope.md remains. Likewise source_store_commit_and_registration_review's commit-scoping half predates commit-source-store-path.sh. Found by re-measuring each member premise against the store rather than ruling from descriptions.

Research report cites --depends-on-remove as the way to reverse an edge; update-task-status.sh (deployed and source store) has no such flag (0 occurrences). Plan names a state-write.sh jq removal as the edge rollback instead.

Plan Phase 1's anchor re-check command (grep -n with the literal file_scope_arr+=("${task_dir}/") pattern) returns no match as written under BRE; the line exists at git-commit-phase.sh:601 and is found with grep -F. A literal reading of the plan would have wrongly recorded the member's premise as unconfirmable.

Seven sequential update-task-status.sh edge_only --depends-on-add calls took over 120s in total because each call regenerates specs/TODO.md; the harness auto-backgrounded the loop at its default timeout during the seventh call. Resolved by a bounded kill -0 wait on the writer PID; all seven exited 0. A batch form of --depends-on-add taking several targets, or a deferred regen, would avoid it.
